english.title: Registration plate supplier obstruct inspection / copy - record
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), obstructed

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_

in the exercise of

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

powers to require

(E)_[production of]_
(F)_[inspection and taking of copies of]_
(G)_[inspection and taking of extracts from]_

records, which a person carrying on business as a registered supplier of registration plates was required to keep at premises occupied by **(..SPECIFY NAME OF OCCUPIER..), wholly or partly for the purposes of

(H)_[his]_
(I)_[her]_

business so far as it consisted of selling registration plates, by virtue of Part 2 of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 26(2)(b) and (7) of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings under this Section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(ii) See section 20(2) for alternative/additional penalty.
(iii) See section 17(2) for clarification of "carries on business as a registration plate supplier".
(iv) See section 26(8) for an "authorised person".
(v) See section 31(1) for other interpretations of Part 2 of the Act.
(vi) See section 24(5) for defence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

NOTE:
Where a registered person is convicted of this offence the court may, instead of or in addition to imposing a fine, by order suspend his registration for any period of up to five years. (section 20(2)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
